definitions.direction: upper wick => bearish reversal hypothesis; lower => bullish
definitions.near_level: wick tip within max($1,0.12 H1 ATR) of pre-confirmed H1/H4 pivot
definitions.pivot_confirmation: H1 3 bars to right, H4 2 bars to right; known before signal candle opens
definitions.entry: next M1 open after M5/M15 signal candle closes
definitions.stop: beyond wick tip by max($0.25,0.05 ATR timeframe)
definitions.r1: 1R favorable before structural stop within next six timeframe candles
definitions.r2: 2R favorable before structural stop within next six timeframe candles
definitions.close: directional move from signal candle close to next 1/3/6 candle close
definitions.spread: assumed constant $0.30 and slippage $0.10 each side
definitions.gaps: uninterrupted future bars required, censored M1 gaps
definitions.overlap: all qualifying signals counted; many overlap and are statistically dependent

warnings: Wick shape alone is not proof of trend reversal; often a pullback.
Pivot proximity may include previously broken levels; flipped side separately labeled.
This is a post-hoc study of wick categories suggested by observation; not out-of-sample validation.
No real execution, commissions or changing broker spreads; overlapping trades not a portfolio.
A wick close pattern does not establish hidden institutional orders.
